subject: SafePath - outage credits, price-match request & migration path
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@safepath.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: SafePath Procurement <procurement@safepath.io>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & credits request after Jun 24 outage / exploring replacement

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this — I'm Ellen (Head of Cloud Ops at SafePath). We had a service interruption with our current vendor on Jun 24 that cost us ~6 hours of degraded inference for a production feature. As procurement, we're running a fast evaluation of alternatives and need two things from potential vendors: a firm price-match / commercial parity with our incumbent and a clear migration assistance package (we're on a mostly on-prem + VPC mix).

Attached is a short workbook with our current spend profile and feature must-haves. High level asks:
- Can you match our current blended unit price (details in sheet "pricing")?
- Will Redwood commit to a one-time outage credit for the incident window (we track credits into our SOW negotiations)?
- What's the expected minimal downtime for a phased cutover (we can't do a big-bang)?

We're working on a July 15 procurement deadline and would appreciate a term sketch by early next week. Marcus (cc'ed) will handle the contract redlines if we get to that point.

Thanks,
Ellen
--
Ellen Park
Head of Cloud Operations, SafePath
[Attachment: SafePath_impact_and_requirements.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@safepath.io>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & credits request after Jun 24 outage / exploring replacement

Ellen — good to meet you, and I'm sorry to hear about the outage. I reviewed the workbook quickly; thank you for sending it. A few quick top-line items so your team can evaluate internally: 

1) Price matching: we can match the incumbent blended unit price on a 12-month consumption commitment, subject to verification of the token volumes in the workbook. We'll outline two options in the term sheet (match w/ 12-month commit and a no-commit 6-month pilot with a smaller credit).

2) Outage credit: Redwood is willing to provide a one-time service credit to address the June 24 event as a commercial gesture (we'll capture this as an SLR credit in the term sheet that auto-applies to your first invoice after migration). We need a short statement of impact from your ops team to finalize the quantum.

3) Migration approach: for on-prem + VPC mixes, our recommended phased path is: pilot (non-prod), canary (subset), cutover (per-service routing), and rollback window. Connor (cc) will supply the minimal runtime compatibility matrix and an estimate of engineering effort for your infra.

I'll get a draft term sheet to you by Monday EOD that includes the price-match option, a migration credit, and a proposed SLA addendum. If Marcus can share the incumbent contract redline priorities, we can be more prescriptive on carveouts.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0182
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@safepath.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & credits request after Jun 24 outage / exploring replacement

Ellen / Sofia — quick technical note from the infra side. I ran a quick pass against the blob in SafePath_impact_and_requirements.xlsx. Highlights:
- Your largest workloads are seq-len 1024, steady-state qps ~12k token/s across 6 services. Those map cleanly to our Dedicated footprint with batching enabled.
- On-prem components: we'll need a short connector (VPN + JIT provisioning) and we recommend enabling KV-prefix caching for the LLM flows to avoid re-warm costs during cutover.
- Estimated effort for the phased migration (pilot + canary + cutover) from Redwood SRE + your infra: ~4-6 weeks calendar, 2 FTE overlap for the cutover week.

Attached is our runtime compatibility summary — it shows the minor config deltas you'll need for model variants and expected memory/latency tradeoffs per host type.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runtime-compatibility-matrix.pdf (pdf)]
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@safepath.io>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@safepath.io>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood term sketch — price-match & migration support (SafePath)

Ellen / Marcus — looping in the commercial lead to put a clear offer on paper. Based on the workbook and Connor's notes, here's an offer we can sign off on quickly: 

Offer summary (high level):
- Price: match incumbent blended unit price for 12 months with a 12-month consumption commitment (min annual spend: $480k).
- Pilot option: 6-week pilot (no-commit) with a $30k pilot credit if you proceed to a paid contract within 45 days of pilot close.
- Outage credit: one-time commercial credit equal to 2x your average daily spend across the impacted services for June 24 (applies as an invoice credit post-migration).
- Migration assistance: dedicated SRE support — 2 FTE during cutover week + migration runbook and automation for VPC connectors. We will absorb the first 40 engineer-hours; additional hours billed at standard professional services rates.
- SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime on Dedicated, with predefined remediation credits (we'll add a draft SLA addendum to the term sheet).

Next steps:
1) If this aligns, I'll send a condensed term sheet + DocuSign for SafePath legal to review (link below).
2) We need a short impact statement from SafePath ops confirming the incident window to finalize the outage credit amount.
3) Proposed kickoff for pilot: week of Jul 19 (timeline gives your team two weeks to review and prep).

DocuSign (term sketch): https://docusign.com/mock/redwood-safepath-term-2027

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the migration plan this week.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Commercials — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-swap-term-sheet-v1.pdf (pdf)]
From: Marcus Li <marcus.li@safepath.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@safepath.io>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood term sketch — price-match & migration support (SafePath)

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clarity. This is aligned with our procurement ask. Two quick confirmations from my side:
1) We'll confirm the incident impact statement (ops will send by EOD Tue).
2) We want the pilot kicked off Jul 19 and will aim to close the pilot contract window within 45 days if signal is green.

Please send the DocuSign and I'll push through our internal procurement approval.

Marcus
Marcus Li
Sr. Procurement Manager, SafePath
